summary: Mexco Energy Corp filed an 8-K announcing a regular annual cash dividend of $0.10 per share, payable June 30, 2026 to holders of record June 15, 2026. The board declared the dividend as a routine capital return; no special-situation event like an acquisition, tender, or restructuring is present. The filing is a standard dividend announcement under Item 8.01, not a transformative corporate event. There are no deal terms, as this is not an M&A or special-situations transaction. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
